articles.title: Five Bright Planets to Spot in November
articles.summary: Saturn shines in the evening, Mars passes Jupiter on November 16, and bright Venus and Mercury light up November's morning skies.

articles.title: Trees Use Hidden 'Muscles' to Stand Up Straight
articles.summary: Poplar trees can sense their own shape. They grow special tension wood on opposite sides of a stem to pull themselves straight again.

articles.title: Scientists May Have Found a Lost Roman City
articles.summary: Scans near Stein found a planned Roman city with a theater for 8,000 people. It may be the lost city of Claudivium, but scientists are not sure yet.
